test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Diminish
solution: The correct answer is **"Grow."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Diminish** means to make or become less. (छोटा होना या छोटा करना, महत्व घटाना; कम होना या करना) • **Example**: *The world’s rainforests are **diminishing**__ fast.* • The antonym of **diminish** is **grow**. • **Grow** means to become larger in size, amount, or degree. (आकार या संख्‍या की दृष्टि से बढ़ना; बड़ा होना) __ • **Example**: *Children **grow**__ so quickly.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, Empty**, is not an antonym of diminish as it means to have nothing inside or to remove everything from a container. (ख़ाली) • **Option 3, Futile**, means pointless or ineffective and is not related to size or quantity. (निरर्थक या अप्रभावी और आकार या मात्रा से संबंधित नहीं है) • **Option 4, Decline**, is a partial antonym of diminish as it also means to become smaller or less, but it is usually used to describe a gradual or continuous decrease rather than a sudden one. ((किसी का) ह्रास होना, क्षीण होना) 178:Tb0a, The correct answer is **"Brief."**
